estimates.assumptions: 1 1/4 cup self-raising flour ≈ 175 g; standard values for white self-raising flour
1/2 cup coconut sugar ≈ 100 g; standard values for granulated coconut sugar
1/3 cup raw cacao powder ≈ 30 g; standard values for unsweetened cocoa powder
1 tsp baking powder ≈ 4 g; standard values for baking powder
2 flax eggs = 2 tbsp (14 g) ground flaxseed + water; standard values for ground flaxseed (fiber ≈ total carbs)
1/2 cup unsweetened almond milk ≈ 120 ml; standard values for unsweetened almond milk
1 tsp vanilla extract ≈ 4 g; standard values for vanilla extract
1/2 cup boiling water ≈ 120 ml; water contributes no carbohydrates
